entries.title: Hebrews 9:1
segments: Then truly the first [tabernacle] had also ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:2
segments: For the first tabernacle was prepared, in which [was] both the lampstand, and the table, and the setting out of the loaves, which is called holy.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:3
segments: And after the second veil [was] a tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

entries.title: Hebrews 9:4
segments: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid all around with gold, in which [was] the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:5
segments: And over it were the cherubs of glory overshadowing the mercy-seat (about which we cannot now speak piece by piece.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:6
segments: Now when these things were ordained in this way, the priests always went into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service [of God].

entries.title: Hebrews 9:7
segments: But once [in] the year into the second the high priest [goes] alone, not without blood, which he offered for himself and for the errors of the people)

entries.title: Hebrews 9:8
segments: the Holy Spirit signifying [by] this [that] the way into the Holiest of all was not yet made manifest while the first tabernacle was still standing.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:9
segments: For it [was] a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices that could not make him who did the service perfect as regards the conscience,

entries.title: Hebrews 9:10
segments: [which stood] only in meats and drinks, and different kinds of washings and fleshly ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:11
segments: But when Christ had become a high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building

entries.title: Hebrews 9:12
segments: nor by the blood of goats and calves, but by [His] own blood [He] entered once for all into the [Holy of] Holies, having obtained eternal redemption [for us].

entries.title: Hebrews 9:13
segments: For if the blood of bulls and of goats and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling the unclean sanctifies to the purifying of the flesh,

entries.title: Hebrews 9:14
segments: how much more shall the blood of Christ (who through [the] eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished spot to God) purge your conscience from dead works to serve [the] living God?

entries.title: Hebrews 9:15
segments: And for this cause He is the Mediator of the new covenant, so that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions [that were] under the first covenant, those who are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:16
segments: For where a covenant [is], the death of him covenanting must be offered.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:17
segments: For a covenant [is] affirmed over [those] dead, since it never has force when the covenanting one is living.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:18
segments: From which we see that neither was the first [covenant] dedicated without blood.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:19
segments: For [when] Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the Law, [he] took the blood of calves and of goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

entries.title: Hebrews 9:20
segments: saying, "This [is] the blood of the covenant which God has enjoined to you."

entries.title: Hebrews 9:21
segments: And likewise he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:22
segments: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood, and without shedding of blood is no remission.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:23
segments: Therefore [it was] necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified [with] these, but the heavenly things themselves were purified with better sacrifices than these.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:24
segments: For Christ has not entered into the [Holy of] Holies made with hands, [which are] the figures of the true, but into Heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:25
segments: Nor yet that He should offer Himself often, even as the high priest enters into the [Holy of] Holies every year with the blood of others

entries.title: Hebrews 9:26
segments: (for then He must have suffered often since [the] foundation of the world), but now once in the end of the world He has appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of Himself.

entries.title: Hebrews 9:27
segments: And as it is appointed to men once to die, but after this the judgment,

entries.title: Hebrews 9:28
segments: so Christ was once offered to bear [the] sins of many. And to those who look for Him He shall appear the second [time] without sin to salvation.
